name: state-chip-rail
description: A rail of mono status chips advances a seek-safe data-state snap machine on a cue schedule: active chip ink on surface, done chips dim, pending chips hollow, optional badges pop beside one state.

vars.description: Comma-separated chip labels in machine order (2 to 8 states).
Comma-separated activation times in seconds, one per advance (state 1 onward). Blank entries use the default even rhythm.
Index of the state the badges pop beside.
Comma-separated badge labels shown beside the badge state. Empty disables.
Accent token family used by the active chip.
How the rail leaves the frame. Default none: the hold ends the film.
